text:
Alex Kim: FYI schedule for Cedar private/VPC deploy — planned window 2026-03-18 02:00-03:30 UTC. Targeting config + model rollout + network policy updates.
Priya Patel: Thanks Alex. Who's on smoke checks and rollback ready? I'll be online for the first hour. :thumbsup:
Jorge Alvarez: I can own smoke checks (app-side). Will run synthetic traffic and validate 200s, lat p50/p95 on the console dashboards.
Sam O'Neill: I'll take infra/egress verification and KMS key handshake. Ping me 10m before cutover.
Lina Chen: I'll coordinate with Customer Success for Cedar contact + post-deploy verification. Have the runbook link?
Alex Kim: Runbook v2 here: https://rw-console/internal/runbooks/cedar-vpc-deploy — also copying critical steps below.
Alex Kim: Deployment steps (high level):
```
1) freeze non-essential autoscaling
2) apply k8s manifest: ingress + networkpolicy
3) rollout model service -> canary 10%
4) run smoke tests
5) increase to 100% if OK
6) revert to previous if failures
```
Priya Patel: Rollback plan: immediate `kubectl rollout undo` to previous replicaset for service/model; networkpolicies are additive so removal should be done if stuck. Also have image tag pinned for quick redeploy.
Jorge Alvarez: Smoke test script (to run from ci-runner):
```
#!/bin/bash
set -e
# auth
curl -s -X POST $AUTH_URL -d '{"client":"ci-runner"}' > /tmp/token
TOKEN=$(cat /tmp/token)
# send 50 reqs
for i in {1..50}; do
  curl -s -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN" "$SVC_URL/v1/generate?prompt=smoke" >/tmp/resp$i &
done
wait
# quick asserts
grep -q "generation" /tmp/resp* || exit 1
```
Sam O'Neill: Ops checklist before cut: confirm dedicated subnet, routes, NGW IAM role, and HSM/KMS policy. I validated the HSM certs earlier today.
Alex Kim: Monitoring hooks: enable extra traces for the route `cedar-prod` and 15m alert threshold for error-rate > 2%. Alert channel #incidents and ops-sre on-call.
ops-sre: noted, will temp mute the auto-scaler alert and watch the app-error channel.
deploy-bot: Scheduled deploy job `deploy/cedar-vpc-2026-03-18` triggered at 2026-03-18T02:00:00Z (ETA ~45m). CI pipeline link: https://ci.internal/pipelines/cedar-vpc-2026-03-18
Priya Patel: Quick question — any DB migrations in this window?
Alex Kim: No schema migrations. Only config toggles and model artifact switch. Good catch.
Jorge Alvarez: If smoke fails, immediate rollback + open a P0 page with logs: `s3://rw-logs/cedar/last-deploy/`. We'll also capture KV cache warmup metrics.
Lina Chen: I'll be on the Zoom for the handoff and will notify the customer after we hit 100% and pass smoke. Zoom link: https://zoom.rw/cedar-deploy
Sam O'Neill: I'll run a preflight at 01:50 UTC and post status here.
Alex Kim: sweet. If anyone needs to change timing, flag by EOD PST today. Otherwise proceed as scheduled. :rocket:
